title: The Compass of the Empty Quarter
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Astrid Ashgrove, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
